contract: Literal full 2^width by 2^width real and rational interval matrices. Physical index is Fin(2^width); wire q uses Nat.testBit q and xor 2^q, so q0 is LSB. Chronological left-action RY/CX word starts at identity. RY outputs c*u-s*v,s*u+c*v at exact rational halfangle, with outward after each instruction output. CX is exact output-row permutation. No midpoint before stage end, no garbage projection, no phase quotient.

frozen_signatures.Instruction: (width : Nat) -> Type; ry(theta : Rat)(target : Fin width), cx(control target : Fin width)(distinct : control != target)
frozen_signatures.intervalStep: {width : Nat} -> Instruction width -> Nat -> Nat -> Matrix (Fin(2^width)) (Fin(2^width)) Interval -> Matrix (Fin(2^width)) (Fin(2^width)) Interval
frozen_signatures.realStep: {width : Nat} -> Instruction width -> Matrix (Fin(2^width)) (Fin(2^width)) Real -> Matrix (Fin(2^width)) (Fin(2^width)) Real
frozen_signatures.intervalWord: {width : Nat} -> List (Instruction width) -> Nat -> Nat -> IntervalMatrix width -> IntervalMatrix width
frozen_signatures.realWord: {width : Nat} -> List (Instruction width) -> RealMatrix width -> RealMatrix width
frozen_signatures.stage_enclosure: forall {width : Nat} (word : List(Instruction width)) (degree bits : Nat) (i j : Fin(2^width)), Mem (intervalWord word degree bits intervalIdentity i j) (realWord word realIdentity i j)
frozen_signatures.stage_midpoint_error: forall {width : Nat} (word : List(Instruction width)) (degree bits : Nat) (i j : Fin(2^width)), abs(realWord word realIdentity i j - Rat.cast(midpoint(intervalWord word degree bits intervalIdentity i j))) <= Rat.cast(((intervalWord word degree bits intervalIdentity i j).hi-(intervalWord word degree bits intervalIdentity i j).lo)/2)
